title: Gearing
text: Note: Buying gear from other players / the auction house is more reliable (and generally cheaper) than attempting to regrade or RNG your way to better gear. For new players, make sure you are taking advantage of your Catch-up Gear Box. General Gearing Guides Check out the Gear section of the Getting Started guide for an overview on the different types of gear. Check out the Gearing Guide for a generalized guide for efficiently gearing up. Check out the Gemming Guide if you need help gemming your catch up armor.
